integrity: Stand-alone standard-library Python and C++17 verifiers are included, and both were run from the submitted sources. No probabilistic checks or inferred finite-to-infinite extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to quantifier ranks three and four. The uniform large-cycle EF bound is proved generally, while sharp small-size thresholds use exhaustive exact deterministic finite computation. Independent scientific audit has not been performed. Historical priority under alternative terminologies is not guaranteed.
title: Sharp rank-three and rank-four Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé spectra of squared cycles
